Alle or Alles? German A1 Word-Choice Practice

Practise alle for a whole plural group and alles for everything in German. Compare verb agreement with translated examples and explained A1 answers.

A1 level4 worked examples4 practice questions

Independent practice by Klarweg. Not an official Goethe exam or assessment.

Understand the difference

Alle can refer to all members of a plural group: Alle Kinder kommen; alle sind da. Alles means everything as a whole and normally takes a singular verb: Alles ist fertig. Alle Menschen refers to people as a group; alles is not the normal pronoun for everybody.

Common mistake to avoid

Use Alle sind da but Alles ist da. The change in pronoun changes whether the verb is plural or singular.

How to practise: read the examples once, cover the English meanings and try explaining the choice aloud. Next, complete all four questions before opening their answers.

Four German examples with English meanings

Pay attention to the exact article, verb position or ending described in the rule.

Worked example 1Alle Gäste haben einen Sitzplatz.All the guests have a seat.
Worked example 2Alles ist für die Reise vorbereitet.Everything is prepared for the journey.
Worked example 3Die Kinder sind alle im Garten.The children are all in the garden.
Worked example 4Ich habe alles in eine Tasche gepackt.I packed everything into one bag.

Practice: choose the right word

Choose alle for the specified plural group and alles for everything. Capitalise the answer at the start of a sentence. Try each question before opening the answer. A dash (—) means no word is needed. Where another answer is possible, the explanation notes it. These are self-check exercises, not exam scoring.

Question 1. ___ Schüler bringen ein Heft mit. (all the students)

Show answer and explanation for question 1

Answer: Alle

Alle modifies the plural noun Schüler; bringen is plural.

Question 2. ___ ist wieder in Ordnung. (everything)

Show answer and explanation for question 2

Answer: Alles

Alles refers to everything and takes singular ist.

Question 3. Die Bücher sind ___ auf dem Regal. (all of them)

Show answer and explanation for question 3

Answer: alle

Alle refers back to the plural books.

Question 4. Ich möchte ___ noch einmal prüfen. (everything)

Show answer and explanation for question 4

Answer: alles

Alles is the object meaning everything.

Revise it so it sticks

Return to this lesson tomorrow and complete the four gaps without looking at the rule. Then write two of your own sentences using today's pattern. Check whether the subject, case and verb position match the explanation.
